title: MGS5VR / CONTROL MODES
edition: Development build / 09 September 2026 / Quest Touch / Action Type

modes.title: 01 / MOVE & HANDLE WEAPONS
rows: Turn; wrist mode owns this stick while open
Hold to ready / fire or throw
Guide the barrel with two hands; pull away to release
Reload / crouch / prone; release ready grip for stance
Articulate fingers; weapons retain their authored grip

modes.title: 02 / LEFT-WRIST EQUIPMENT
rows: Open picker; left stick still moves you
Up: primary / Down: secondary / Right: support / Left: items
Center, then flick to a card
All eight directions work; center between choices
Back to categories / Use selected item

modes.title: 03 / COMMANDS & RECON
rows: Choose an available buddy or arm command
Confirm once; release left trigger to close
Stand or crouch first; then choose the horse call
Native marking, analysis and authored scopes remain unfinished

modes.title: 04 / GRENADES, MELEE & BODIES
rows: Finish wrist selection, then hold right grip
Position and aim the throw arc; right trigger throws
Native CQC, attack or carried-body throw
Equip ability, then right grip + right trigger; native charge rules
Enemy motion-hit reactions, powered arms and physical body grabs

modes.title: 05 / iDROID, PAUSE & TITLE
rows: Pause; inside iDroid this opens Help
A opens confirmation; choose the native confirmation
Choose Skip and press A when the native game offers it

modes.title: 06 / HORSE, VEHICLES & VR
rows: Acquire wheel; rotate wrist to steer; release to let go
Enter or leave tracked VR after Resume Game
Personal-gun fire through a driver's window
Loading, cutscenes, later abilities and vehicle states

footer: Experimental controls. A mapped input is not a claim that every gameplay state is finished. Full details: docs/CONTROLS.md
